subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which authorized operator and cutover method should establish official ownership of the production GitHub OAuth application without interrupting ClawHub web or CLI authentication?
rationale: OAuth application custody, production client secrets, and rollback access are privileged operational boundaries that cannot be selected or exercised through an automated repository repair.

options.title: Transfer the existing application
options.body: Transfer the current OAuth application to the official organization, update its branding and URLs, rotate the secret if required, and capture live web and CLI proof.

options.title: Stage an official replacement
options.body: Create an official organization-owned OAuth application and perform a planned credential cutover with verified callbacks and a rollback path.

recommendation.title: Transfer the existing application
recommendation.body: Transfer the current OAuth application to the official organization, update its branding and URLs, rotate the secret if required, and capture live web and CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior same-root-cause issue was assigned to this person, providing the clearest available operational routing signal.
